title: Autonomous Assessment of Generalizability of AI Agent Capabilities
abstract: arXiv:2512.16733v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Safe deployment of black-box AI (BBAI) systems such as foundation model agents requires methods for evaluating their capabilities in novel settings. We define an agent's capability as its ability to achieve a short term objective and formalize the problem of learning models that predict whether, with what effects, and under what conditions, an agent can perform a capability. We introduce Monte Carlo Query Search (MCQS), an active query-synthesis method for learning symbolic stochastic capability models of BBAIs. MCQS models capabilities as conditional probability distributions over outcomes and formulates capability evaluation as an active learning problem over policies. We use Monte Carlo tree search to synthesize queries that maximally distinguish between extremal capability hypotheses: the lattice meet and join corresponding to the most pessimistic and optimistic models consistent with observed behavior. translated_title: AI智能体能力泛化性的自主评估
translated_abstract: 基础模型智能体等黑盒人工智能（BBAI）系统的安全部署，需要能够在全新环境中评估其能力的方法。我们将智能体的能力定义为其达成短期目标的本领，并对预测“智能体能否执行某项能力、会产生何种效果、以及在何种条件下能够执行”的模型学习问题进行了形式化。我们提出了蒙特卡洛查询搜索（MCQS），这是一种用于学习黑盒AI系统符号化随机能力模型的主动查询合成方法。MCQS将能力建模为结果上的条件概率分布，并将能力评估形式化为策略空间上的主动学习问题。我们利用蒙特卡洛树搜索来合成能够最大程度区分极端能力假设的查询，即与已观测行为相一致的最悲观模型与最乐观模型所对应的格交与格并。执行这些查询可获得……
tldr: 本文提出蒙特卡洛查询搜索（MCQS）方法，通过蒙特卡洛树搜索主动合成查询来学习黑盒AI系统的符号化随机能力模型，从而自主评估AI智能体能否执行某项能力、在何种条件下执行以及执行效果如何。
